notes: Squeek (SQK) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no administrative powers, transfer fees, or external mint or burn functions. No application contracts are included. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
